description: Will this Base transaction revert? Prospective-tx dry-run via eth_simulateV1: pass from, to, optional data (0x calldata) and value (wei) and get will_revert + revert_reason + gas_used + token asset_changes BEFORE the agent spends gas sending it. Keyless, Base-native, Tenderly/Alchemy-class output with no API key. Use before a swap/approve/transfer or alongside gate_swap. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

data.description: Optional 0x calldata (omit for a plain transfer)

to.description: Target contract or address (0x, Base) — required

value.description: Optional wei to send (decimal or 0x hex)

name: simulate
